- docs: 对外的面向开发者|用户等各种用户的手册|教程文档的存放位置，面向不同的人群，要根据人群的特征，编写易于阅读和理解的规范的文档，每个文档都有中英两个文件，如README.md英文+README.cn.md中文
- Typescript: 单元测试使用 vitest
- 源码编写规范，每个包|文件|类|函数等都需要保持单一职责，单文件300行以内（硬约束），单函数/方法30行以内；包内源文件数不设硬上限、按职责聚合，超过约20个源文件或出现第二职责域时按领域拆分新包（如 forum-governance），不做机械切分
- 编写代码之前，先使用 apps\cli 开发的cli工具，查看已有功能，避免重复造轮子，也可以将代码放在适当的包内，然后评估确定(添加依赖|自己造轮子)方案
- 在编写子包时，使用pnpm cli list name 查看这个包的依赖的第三方工具包
- 编写插件必须使用"@deepseek-ai/schemastery"定义config
- 插件的 DSH 依赖只写 peerDependencies+devDependencies，版本契约只写 engines.dsh；`dependencies` 里出现 cordis/dsh-* 会装出第二份实例（门禁 `pnpm check:plugins`，规则见 docs/dsh-plugin-versions.cn.md）
- 版本号规范：`@veren/*` 单版本线统一升位（SemVer，MAJOR=契约/数据破坏、MINOR=新能力、PATCH=其余一切——registry 不可变，任何内容变更先 bump 再发布，禁撞号禁跳号）；MAJOR 必须走 `-rc.N` 预发布先过预发布环境；提交成笔 `chore(release): X.Y.Z - 主题` 并打 tag `vX.Y.Z`（规范见 docs/versioning.cn.md）
- vendor目录下的内容禁止修改，存放一些第三方的源码
- 比较重要的Service自定义生命周期：Service.init/Service.check/Service.invoke，调试用Service.tracker
- 插件类型支持Plugin.Function<T> 禁止 default export |Plugin.Constructor<T> export default class X extends Service |Plugin.Object<T>，注意inject依赖的是能力(Service)
- 所有注册动作要确保卸载时逆序清理，不会泄漏
- 事件系统 emit(通知)|parallel(通知)|serial(拦截)|bail(拦截)|waterfall(加工)
- 创建带附加元数据的子 context: ctx.extend(meta); 为服务名开辟独立作用域: ctx.isolate(name, label?); 为子树注入服务配置覆盖: ctx.intercept(name, config)
- src/types.ts 只放类型，测试放包级 tests/
- vitest.config.ts *.spec.ts 单测 | vitest.e2e.config.ts *.e2e.ts 真实 API、花 token，无凭据自跳过，retry: 2
- 规范："单独跑才过的 spec 是缺陷"（必须并发安全）；registry 贡献必须带 dispose/HMR 安全测试；插件要有走真实 Loader 的 composition 测试
- 可复用的测试基建（Reusable test-support packages，优先复用，不要重复造轮子）位于 deepseek\deepseek-harness\packages\test-support\：
  - `agent-loop-testkit` – agent 循环测试工具 / agent loop test toolkit
  - `client-runtime` – 客户端运行时测试支持 / client runtime test support
  - `llm-mock-server` – LLM mock 服务器 / mock LLM server
  - `llm-replay` – LLM 录制回放 / LLM record & replay
  - `loader-smoke` – Loader 冒烟测试 / loader smoke tests
  - `remote-mock` – 远端 mock / remote endpoint mock
  - `session-snapshot` – 会话快照 / session snapshot utilities
- waterfall 监听器必须调 next()，否则短路整条链（事件契约的强制面）
- 事件类型走 declaration merging，JSDoc 必须标注 @mode（emit/bail/...）
- 跨边界 id 用 brand（Branded<B> = string & {...}，零运行时开销）；闭集 union 用 assertNever 收尾
- 错误要结构化：带稳定 code（如 SETTINGS_CONFLICT）+ 机器可读字段；misconfiguration fails loud
- 本地导入带 .ts 后缀、全 ESM NodeNext；spawn 前环境净洗（剥 KEY/PASSWORD/SECRET/TOKEN 和 DSH_*，大小写不敏感——Windows 陷阱）


```ts
export const DemoToken = defineToken<DemoService>(`demoToken`)
export class DemoService extends Service {
    constructor(ctx: Context){
        super(ctx, DemoToken)
    }
}
```

```ts
    // todo
```

- 推荐client 插件写法，使用react + tsx + css module + 组件化 + 多主题 + 多语言 + 复用基础设施 如: Toast/Dialog等，放在插件目录下的 src/client/目录中
1. 复用dsh组件库
2. 复用dsh客户端Service
3. 复用dsh 钩子如： useWorkspaces等
4. 复用dsh 多主题
5. 复用dsh 多语言 ctx.effect(() => ctx.locale.register(NS, { zh, en }), '...')
6. 铁律一：往别人的 slot 注册，必须用 ctx.slots.inject(name, () => ctx.slots.register(...))
7. 铁律二：children = 声明 + 授权。你渲染哪些子 slot，注册项的 children 就必须恰好声明哪些（kind: 'single'|'list'|'keyed' + scope）
8. 组件 props 全部是派生共享，禁止手写：PropsRuntime（owner 数据）、PropsRenderSlots（children）、PropsStore、PropsHooks（inject 的 hooks 面）、PropsLocale。这些类型别名都从 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots 取
9. inject 工厂只返回普通数据和回调（apply 闭包里的东西）——禁止手造钩子、禁止返回 ReactNode、禁止返回整个 Service 对象。动态事实必须包成 HostObservable（{ getSnapshot, subscribe }，且源对象与快照引用保持稳定）放进 hooks。
10. ctx 只属于 apply 世界：组件永不接触 ctx、不 import Service 类、不读 React context。组件要新东西 = 从 owner site / store / inject face 穿一根 prop 下来。
11. 业务数据活在对象层（Session/Workspace Controller），store 只放查看/交互状态（选中、草稿、面板宽度）。
12. 派生数据是框架钩子数据上的纯函数（derive/useMemo），不自己订阅。
```ts
// 类型-only import：只为拉取各 Service 的 declaration merge（ctx.slots、ctx.locale 等）
import type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client'
// 服务级注入：cordis fiber 等待这些**服务**，这才是真正的激活顺序
export const inject = ['slots', 'sessions', 'workspaces', 'locale', ...]
export function apply(ctx: Context): void { ... }
```

- 稳定测试节点（长期存在、可反复用、源码直接起；手动/交互验证一律用它）
  - 目录: DSH_HOME=deepseek\.dsh（即工作区下 deepseek\.dsh）；密钥已就位：`.credentials.yaml` 是从 ~/.dsh **只读复制**来的 dev 自己副本，credentials-local 只读它；对 ~/.dsh 只允许"复制出去"，禁止回写

  - 版本依据: 源码检出 `deepseek\deepseek-harness` 为 `master@687f282e86`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-root 0.2.1-rc.2`，与桌面运行时（54224）**同版本、差为 0**——用源码验证即可代表真机

  - 装插件: `pnpm --dir deepseek\deepseek-harness dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库插件路径>`（源码版 CLI 支持本地路径安装；我们的包 engines.dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` 恰好匹配，装组合包如 `plugins\app-host-bundle`，成员包不单独装）；`workspace:^` 依赖在路径安装时解析失败时的**唯一例外**才是 tarball + `scripts/repack.mjs` 重写依赖（装的目标仍是稳定节点的 web profile，不是临时节点）。**产物政策**：源码进 git、产物进包——`dist`/`lib` 构建产物一律不入库（.gitignore，含 `*.map`），`files` 白名单负责把产物装进包，同步靠各包 `prepack: pnpm run build`（`pnpm pack` 自动触发，不许赌"打包的人记得先 build"）；`check:entries` 会检查 `exports` 全部子路径（含 `./client`）在打包形态下存在。**唯一例外**：被以 git 仓库/源码路径形式直接安装的包触发不了 prepack，产物必须提交入库——只有确按直装分发的包才能援引此例外，新包默认走 tarball/包管理器安装，不得拿它当不构建的挡箭牌

  - 隔离结论: 该 home 与 `~/.dsh`、54224 桌面版**无共享状态**（profile/storages/凭据全在 dev home 内）；唯一例外：`~/.agents`（设计上的共享 agents 根，只读）与 pnpm store（靠上面的 `.npmrc` 隔离）

  - 真机验证清单（原 `@veren/app-host-verify` 探针已删，自动化部分收编进 `plugins\app-host\tests\assembly.spec.ts`；以下各项**只能在真实宿主里人肉验**，照抄执行）：

tools.name: app_list
tools.description: 列出当前宿主已安装的所有应用。返回 { apps: [...] }，每项含：id、name、description、entryUrl（入口页面 URL，形如 /apps/<appId>/...；broken 应用为 null）、state（active 可用 / disabled 已禁用 / broken 损坏，附 brokenReason）、toolPrefix。只把 state 为 active 且 entryUrl 非 null 的应用当作可用；拿到 entryUrl 后用 app_open 工具（参数 url=entryUrl）打开应用入口。

tools.name: app_open
tools.description: Open an application page URL (for example /apps/review-workbench/task/1) or take a task with taskId. It always creates a fresh page session with the page’s tools mounted and returns it; a previous session on the same url is deprecated automatically and never addressed via the url again. Your own session, tools, and history never change. Failures carry stable codes: app/not-found, app/disabled, page/not-found, task/expired.

taskId.description: Task id to take after the page session is open (task workflow).

tools.name: app_pages
tools.description: 列出某个应用的全部页面。参数：appId（先用 app_list 查到）。返回 { appId, pages: [...] }，每项含：pageKey（形如 <appId>/<pageName>）、urlPattern（形如 /apps/<appId>/...，:xxx 为路径参数）、description、isEntry（是否入口页）、tools（本页可用的工具最终名列表）。要打开某页：把 urlPattern 中的 :参数 替换为实际值得到具体 URL，再用 app_open 工具（参数 url）打开。

appId.description: 应用 id，来自 app_list 的返回

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: im_bind
tools.description: Authorize an IM account. Start with method (qrcode, oauth, token, or password). QR flow returns bindId plus a local PNG path; poll later with bindId only. When a poll reports status needs-code, resend with bindId plus the code the user read from their phone; any other poll needs bindId only. This never binds a conversation; use im_link for that.

provider.description: Provider id; omit when exactly one provider is registered.

method.description: Authorization method; mutually exclusive with bindId.

label.description: Display name for the new account.

bindId.description: Poll an existing attempt; mutually exclusive with method.

code.description: Verification code shown by the user's phone when the last poll returned needs-code; requires bindId.

tools.name: im_intake
tools.description: Read the automatic stranger-intake switch and its audit trail. Returns enabled, the exact askText, replyWindowMs, per-account rate limits, status counts, and recent records (who, which account/conversation, when, what was sent, reply outcome). It is read-only: change strangerIntake.enabled in the im plugin config to switch it off. A self-reported name appears as claimedName with identityStatus=self-reported; never treat it as a verified realName.

limit.description: Recent records to return; default 20, maximum 100.

tools.name: im_list
tools.description: List IM accounts or the per-conversation message-queue state without changing anything. Omit type to return both.

tools.name: im_people
tools.description: List or search the known people directory. Each record has a nickname (displayName), optional realName, aliases/remarks, contacts (wechat/email/phone/other), bio, and reachable addresses (provider + accountId + conversationId). A person may also carry claimedName/claimedContacts from the automatic stranger question: that is the person's own unverified statement, shown with identityStatus=self-reported, and must never be presented as a verified realName. For what the person said about themselves in conversation, use im_person_report; this tool is for verified information. Call this before im_send when the user names someone. This tool only browses: im_send performs the exact match and refuses ambiguity.

query.description: Substring filter over names, aliases, contacts, ids, and addresses; omit to list all.

provider.description: Only people reachable through this provider, for example wechat.

accountId.description: Only people reachable through this account.

limit.description: Maximum people to return; default 50, maximum 200.

tools.name: im_person_report
tools.description: Record what one person said about themselves in conversation (their claimed name and/or offered contacts) after the automatic stranger question or an unprompted self-report. Judge the meaning of their messages yourself, then report only clearly stated facts here: this writes the unverified self-reported claim (shown as claimedName, identityStatus=self-reported), never realName or aliases. Set refused=true when the person declined to answer; that closes the open question without recording anything. A field that fails a format check is dropped and named in the result, so you may ask the person again.

personId.description: The person reporting; or give accountId + conversationId.

accountId.description: Account of the conversation the report came from.

name.description: The name the person clearly used for themselves.

contacts.description: JSON array of { kind: wechat|email|phone|other, value, label? } the person offered.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.
